puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattam'pi tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo.

50375.meaning2: fit to be enjoyed or possessed

examples.text: aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo rāj'āraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi aṭṭhahi?
rājabhoggo'ti rājato bhoggaṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ ass'atthī'ti rājabhoggo, rājabhogo'ti'pi pāṭho, rājato bhogo assa atthī'ti attho.

50377.commentary: (DNa) bhoggan'ti khandhe, kaṭiyaṃ, jāṇūsū'ti tīsu ṭhānesu bhoggavaṅkaṃ. (MNa) bhoggan'ti bhaggaṃ, iminā'pi'ssa vaṅkabhāvam'eva dīpeti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattaṃ.
bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅ'gamo.
vāṇijja raṭṭh'ādhipa gacchamāno, pathe addasāsimhi bhojaputte, pavaddhakāyaṃ uragaṃ mahantaṃ, ādāya gacchante pamodamāne.
māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti, indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, bhojane mattaññū hoti, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
acelako ce'pi, kassapa, hoti, mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojana-anuyogam'anuyutto viharati.
